query: SELECT p.id, p.name, pi.color, pi.imageUrl FROM products p JOIN productImages pi ON p.id = pi.productId WHERE p.id IN (1, 5, 10, 20, 40, 60) AND pi.color != 'label' ORDER BY p.id, pi.color LIMIT 30
